_meta.description: SR-specific champion builds for coach_integration.py SR coaching.
_meta.notes: Different from ARAM builds — SR starts 450g, no ARAM buffs, matchup-dependent first items

Vayne.first_back: Recurve Bow (800g) or Long Sword if <800g
Vayne.vs_tanks: Kraken + BotRK + Rageblade is the full tank-shred setup
Vayne.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 5th or 6th — always vs sustain supports
Vayne.build_note: Rush Kraken first — % HP on-hit defines her anti-tank. BotRK second for lifesteal + active. Rageblade converts crit to double on-hit synergy. Play safe until Kraken complete.
Vayne.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve) or 1100g (Recurve + Long Sword). Never sit at 500g — wasteful.

Jinx.vs_tanks: LDR 5th — Collector(25%) + RFC(25%) + IE(25%) = 75% crit active before LDR
Jinx.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR if 2+ sustain — never both
Jinx.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector if 3+ divers
Jinx.build_note: Yun Tal gives AS not crit in S16. Need RFC for 25% crit, then Collector for 50% before IE. IE fully activates at 75% total. Never switch to rockets until Yun Tal complete — minigun stacks plates faster.
Jinx.recall_timing: Back at 1050g (Yun Tal component BF Sword) or 900g (Recurve + pickaxe path).

Tristana.vs_tanks: LDR 4th — physical burst scales with armor pen
Tristana.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Tristana.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Stormrazor vs heavy burst
Tristana.build_note: Collector first for early execute + plates value. Stormrazor slows make E all-ins guaranteed. Never use W offensively when behind — it's your escape. E stacks: 3 on tower before 14min = plates gold.
Tristana.recall_timing: Back at 1300g (BF Sword) or 875g (Pickaxe). Never sit on 500g.

Caitlyn.vs_tanks: LDR 4th — headshot crits + LDR shreds tanks through armor
Caitlyn.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Caitlyn.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs burst
Caitlyn.build_note: Hexoptics C44 (25% crit + 55 AD) is her best first item — headshot every 6 autos. RFC extends headshot range to 850+. Hexoptics + RFC = 50% crit before IE, IE activates at 75% total.
Caitlyn.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Hexoptics C44 half-item). E is escape only — never burn offensively.

Nilah.first_back: Recurve Bow (800g) or Long Sword if < 800g
Nilah.vs_tanks: Kraken Slayer + BotRK core — never skip either
Nilah.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder 4th — melee range means you sustain fight long enough for it to matter
Nilah.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow 3rd provides shield during melee all-in
Nilah.build_note: All-in ONLY on confirmed ally CC. E flip = engage AND escape — never use without a CC chain. W active reduces enemy healing. Melee ADC in lane — play passive until jungler comes or level 6.
Nilah.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). Never extend when support is dead.

Miss Fortune.first_back: BF Sword (1300g) or Caulfield's Warhammer (1100g) vs armor
Miss Fortune.vs_tanks: LDR mandatory — Collector(25%) + Phantom Dancer(20%) + IE(25%) = 70% crit active
Miss Fortune.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR — never both
Miss Fortune.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs heavy burst
Miss Fortune.build_note: Strut (W) stacks when out of combat — don't get poked. E rain slows then Bullet Time = guaranteed full channel. Ult angle: perpendicular to enemy team, 30-45 degrees for max spread.
Miss Fortune.recall_timing: Back at 1300g (BF Sword for Collector) or 1100g (Caulfield's vs all-in threat).

Lucian.vs_tanks: LDR 5th — TF Spellblade + Navori haste means more Q cycles amplifying LDR
Lucian.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Lucian.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs 3+ divers — always keep TF
Lucian.build_note: Trinity Force is MANDATORY first item. Q activates Spellblade AND Lightslinger: bonus damage + empowered auto + second auto = 3-hit burst. Rush TF via Long Sword → Caulfield's → Sheen. Never RFC.
Lucian.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Caulfield's Warhammer) or 800g (Pickaxe + Dagger). TF complete by 12-13min target.

Ezreal.first_back: Tear of the Goddess (400g) — buy at first recall regardless of gold
Ezreal.vs_tanks: LDR + Serylda's double armor pen — Q applies both
Ezreal.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Ezreal.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs assassins
Ezreal.build_note: Buy Tear FIRST back no matter what — stack immediately via Q spam. TF Spellblade + Muramana on Q = core damage. Serylda's slows enemies on Q hit. E is your ONLY escape — never burn forward.
Ezreal.recall_timing: Buy Tear at first recall (400g). Full Manamune stacked = power spike. TF complete ~14min.

Jhin.vs_tanks: LDR 4th — 4th shot crit + LDR procs through armor stacks
Jhin.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Jhin.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs burst
Jhin.build_note: Jhin gains AD from crit chance — more crit items = more AD passive. RFC 4th shot at 850 range crits for 30%+ HP squishy. Plan 4th shot as the execute. W root sets up R.
Jhin.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (BF Sword path) or 875g (Pickaxe). Reload window forces repositioning — track enemy aggression.

Ashe.vs_tanks: LDR mandatory — perma-slow keeps tanks in LDR proc range
Ashe.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Ashe.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs assassins
Ashe.build_note: RFC + max range Frost Shot crits at 850+ range. Ranger's Focus (Q) at 4 stacks: AOE cone slow. Crystal Arrow (R) is global — throw at fight start, then engage. Always have R available at objectives.
Ashe.recall_timing: Back at 875g (Pickaxe) or 800g (Recurve Bow). Stack Ranger's Focus on minions before trades.

Draven.vs_tanks: LDR 5th — Collector(25%) + Phantom Dancer(20%) + Navori(25%) + IE(25%) = 95% crit
Draven.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Draven.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Phantom Dancer vs heavy burst
Draven.build_note: Catch BOTH Spinning Axes on every throw — lose axes = lose stacks. League of Draven passive stacks on every kill. Convert stacks with R on low-HP escaping enemies. Caulfield's rush for early haste.
Draven.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Caulfield's) or 1300g (BF Sword). Never extend when axes are dropped.

Xayah.vs_tanks: LDR 5th — Yun Tal(0%) + RFC(25%) + Collector(25%) + IE(25%) = 75% crit
Xayah.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Xayah.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs assassins
Xayah.build_note: Yun Tal gives AS not crit in S16 — need RFC as crit bridge. Plant feathers with autos, E pulls all through the group. R (Featherstorm) is invincible — use to dodge Malphite R, Lux R, any burst.
Xayah.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow) to start Yun Tal path. Never use R proactively — save for incoming burst.

Samira.vs_tanks: LDR 5th — Collector(25%) + Navori(25%) + ISB(25%) + IE(25%) = 100% crit
Samira.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Samira.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow already in core build
Samira.build_note: Style rank D→S via alternating melee Q / ranged auto + using ally CC nearby. R (Inferno Trigger) only at S rank — build rank on 3+ enemies before R. Weave through grouped enemies with passive dashes.
Samira.recall_timing: Back at 1100g (Caulfield's). Don't extend when style rank is below C — vulnerable before R available.

Sivir.vs_tanks: LDR 4th — Boomerang Blade (Q) procs LDR through groups
Sivir.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Sivir.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster vs assassins
Sivir.build_note: Navori reduces Q/W cooldown on crit — Ricochet (W) bounces become constant. Spell Shield (E) blocks one ability — save for hard CC or Caitlyn R. On-hit from Ricochet stacks Q haste faster.
Sivir.recall_timing: Back at 875g (Pickaxe). Q/W to clear waves fast — crash and recall every 3 waves.

Varus.first_back: Recurve Bow (800g) or Pickaxe if ahead
Varus.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR — W blight + Kraken true damage shreds through max armor
Varus.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Varus.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces The Collector vs assassins
Varus.build_note: W (Blighted Quiver): stack 3 blight with autos, then E root detonates for % max HP burst. R chain of corruption jumps between enemies — throw into grouped cluster at objectives.
Varus.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). Never Q charge in place — stationary = gank target.

Kalista.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR — Rend detonates Kraken procs through tanks simultaneously
Kalista.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Kalista.build_note: NEVER stand still — every auto hops to new position. Stack 4+ spears on target before Rend (E). Hurricane plants spears on 3 targets simultaneously. R throws support into enemy team — coordinate the timing.
Kalista.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). Kalista needs AS more than AD early — Recurve first is correct.

Zeri.vs_tanks: Kraken + LDR + Rageblade double on-hit synergy
Zeri.vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces LDR vs sustain — never both
Zeri.vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Guinsoo's vs heavy assassin
Zeri.build_note: Q (Burst Fire) passes through minions — chip enemies through waves for free. E (Spark Surge) wall-hop for flank angles or escape. R overcharge: every kill extends — all-in at 2+ enemies grouped.
Zeri.recall_timing: Back at 800g (Recurve Bow). E wall-hops available — use to find safe recall paths.
